rating_dispersion_cfb_dispersion_temper_.description: College-first rating-dispersion family, dispersion_temper: the served-equivalent logit times standardized D, D the per-game standard deviation of predicted margins across Prediction Tracker computer systems (market and aggregate columns excluded), so one coefficient shrinks or stretches confidence. One offset-logistic coefficient on the leave-one-season-out ridge cover probability with the opener as input and grade, 13 seasons; declared sign negative. Changed picks 41, record 14-27; coefficient per SD -0.0440; season halves -0.0528 and -0.0340; percentile 1.0 of 200 within-season shuffles of D; in-sample minus held-out +0.081633.
rating_dispersion_cfb_dispersion_temper_.notes: Family rating_dispersion_cfb_u1: 2 candidates x 3 metrics = 6 recorded cells; 2 gating log-loss reads in the matched null, 4 season-half coefficients; declared in artifacts/rating_dispersion/declaration.json before the outcome join; survivor: no.
